data.name: Humphrey
data.long_meaning: The Old English name Humphrey is composed of two elements: 'hug' and 'freo'. The former means 'heart', while the latter translates to 'gracious' or 'dear'. This name is believed to have originated as a nickname for someone who displayed these qualities.
